ledger: ANCHORS: counter (runs front-to-back, stools on dining side), kitchen pass-through window (warm lit), front window with OPEN neon sign, back door with EXIT sign
shot 1: 00:00-00:10, exterior wide static; diner at dusk, white semi tractor+trailer parked left with steam at rear, OPEN sign lit
shot 2: 00:12-00:18, interior from dining side; waitress (blue shirt, white apron, glasses on collar) behind counter wiping with cloth, exits frame right; pass-through and clock in background
shot 3: 00:20-00:28, interior wide from dining room; man (brown jacket, plaid shirt) enters from rear, walks to counter stool and sits; waitress pours coffee across counter
shot 4: 00:30-00:32, close-up counter; coffee pot (held from upper right) pours into white mug; man's hands resting at frame left
shot 5: 00:34-00:36, close-up plate; cornbread slice + fried egg, steam rising; fork/knife at right
shot 6: 00:38-00:44, interior wide; man alone at counter with mug and plate, facing camera; no waitress visible
shot 7: 00:46-00:52, reverse angle from kitchen side; waitress wiping in foreground, man seated at counter in background through pass
shot 8: 00:54-01:00, same angle as shot 2; diner completely empty, light now dawn-bright (time-jump dissolve)
shot 9: 01:02-01:08, wide from dining room; man back at counter, head down, mug in front; waitress enters from right and moves toward him
shot 10: 01:10-01:18, medium two-shot; waitress sets plate before man, then picks it back up and walks off toward rear carrying it (70.8 is dissolve transition)
shot 11: 01:21-01:27, wide; waitress returns from rear without plate, comes around counter end and sits on stool beside man, both with mugs

shot 12: 01:29-01:35, close two-shot from kitchen side; man and waitress side by side at counter facing camera, sunrise through windows behind; waitress on man's right (camera-left), consistent with shot 11 seating
shot 13: 01:37, counter empty, same angle as shots 2/8 (time-jump dissolve)
shot 14: 01:39-01:41, close-up counter; hand from left places folded $100 bill beside white mug, second hand from right slides/takes it

shot 15: 01:43-01:51, through front window; man walks out to a dark green box truck (different vehicle from shot 1's white semi) and reaches cab door; waitress watches from inside, her reflection in glass (out of scope)
shot 16: 01:53-01:57, interior wide in bright sunlight; waitress alone walks along counter toward rear, bends near pass; man absent (left off-screen)
waitress state: present shots 2,3,7,9,10,11,12,15,16; kitchen side of counter in 2,3,7,9,10; crosses to dining side between 10 and 11 (elided by cut, counter end passable); absent in 1,4,5,6,8,13,14

man state: present shots 3,4(hands only),6,7(background),9,10,11,12,14(hand only),15; dining side of counter at near-end stool in all interior appearances; absent shots 2,8,13 during dissolves marked by lighting change; exits off-screen before 16
mug: white mug with man shots 6-12, on counter in shot 14 close-up; plate: appears shot 5-6, removed by waitress shot 10, re-served and removed again within shot 10
coffee pot: in waitress's right hand shots 3-4, pour continuous into shot 4 close-up, same person same hand
vehicle: white semi+trailer shot 1 (exterior, leaves frame); green box truck shot 15 arrives from off-screen across overnight time jump - off-screen swap, not an on-screen mutation of the same object
